image_prompt: A middle-aged Prussian military officer rendered in cyberpunk anime style. He has a severe, angular face with sharp cheekbones and a thin-lipped, disapproving expression. His hair is steel-gray, slicked back in rigid military precision with a few synthetic-looking highlights suggesting neon undertones. His eyes are cold and calculating, rendered with the characteristic large anime pupils but conveying detachment and constraint. He wears a high-collared military uniform in dark grays and blacks with geometric neon trim along the edges—cyan and purple accents that suggest futuristic military insignia. The uniform is perfectly tailored and austere, with minimal ornamentation. His shoulders are broad but not imposing, conveying authority through rigid posture rather than physical presence. Thin metal circuitry patterns trace along his jawline and temples, suggesting cybernetic enhancement typical of cyberpunk aesthetics. His expression is perpetually stern, mouth set in a thin line. He appears around 55-60 years old with weathered skin that contrasts sharply with the digital artifacts overlaid across his features. His overall appearance combines rigid Prussian formality with dystopian futuristic elements.
book_context: Catherine the Great: A Life (or similar biographical work on Catherine II)
